title: metais.init/1
description: What metais init prints with --json: the files of the scaffold it wrote, or with --dry-run would write (ADR-007 D1 item 5, ADR-008 D9).

dry_run.description: Whether --dry-run was given, so that nothing was written.

files.description: Each file written, or that would be written, as a path relative to the directory init writes into, in the order written.
